candidate.label: TitanTPP-HardLMM Separate-Key Sparse Retrieval
candidate.only_change_vs_weighted_control: untie addressing keys from the static prototype values
candidate.hypothesis: independent addressing may distinguish histories that currently share concentrated prototype selections; concentration is not a proven performance bottleneck

retrieval.query: original masked local encoder output h; no new query projection
retrieval.score: cosine(h, memory_keys), same normalization epsilon as weighted control
retrieval.time_and_quantity_state: masked h+r, shared by the unchanged heads
retrieval.selected_score_gradient: ordinary autograd through softmax and cosine to selected keys and h
retrieval.index_gradient: none; no straight-through estimator or differentiable top-k relaxation
retrieval.unselected_key_gradient: zero from that query; AdamW decay may still change parameters
retrieval.degenerate_gradient_caveat: topk=1, identical values or a zero downstream head can produce zero addressing gradient; official topk remains 4
retrieval.external_memory_override: rejected; a value-only override cannot specify independent addressing keys
retrieval.state_scope: static task parameters; no online or per-series mutable memory

initialization.values_and_all_original_parameters: same fresh seeded initialization and RNG draws as original and weighted Hard-LMM
initialization.keys: detached clone of freshly initialized values; separate storage; no extra RNG draws
initialization.initial_output_identity: exact weighted-control identity on CPU at equal inputs, mode and RNG, not original uniform-Hard-LMM identity
initialization.training: all parameters trainable; no frozen encoder, fine-tuning or silent checkpoint conversion
initialization.gradient_identity: at tied initial keys/values, weighted bank gradient equals candidate key gradient plus candidate value gradient
initialization.capacity_caveat: untied keys add parameters and change optimizer dynamics; this is not a parameter-count-matched proof or a claim of equal training trajectories

unchanged.quantity_head: existing linear + softplus log location + expm1 prediction
unchanged.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation joint objective; strict improvement; earliest tie

data_boundary.target_quantity_in_encoder: masked_zero by the existing target_outputs path
data_boundary.prediction_position: last observed event at length-2 in the right-padded target-inclusive batch
data_boundary.target_duration: density evaluation only; causal masking prevents use in the history prediction

comparison_and_reuse.original_role: official performance reference; not replaced by weighted control
comparison_and_reuse.weighted_role: isolates key/value untying; candidate-vs-original also changes aggregation
reuse_requirements: record runtime differences rather than claim bitwise historical replay
comparison_and_reuse.missing_weighted_control: no clean isolated key/value attribution on that dataset until a separately approved matched control is completed

prior_overlap_audit.GatedSoftMemory: already has independent keys/values, query/key/value/output projections, dense retrieval and zero-init gate; not the isolated sparse untie contrast
prior_overlap_audit.TPPSpecificGatedMemory: already combines projected sparse retrieval with confidence/null selection and observed-event online writes; not the isolated static untie contrast
prior_overlap_audit.weighted_static: same cosine top-4 softmax tau=1, with tied addressing/value bank
prior_overlap_audit.claim_limit: independent keys are an established mechanism, not a new invention or demonstrated TPP contribution

prospective_screening_not_authorized.optimizer: original AdamW, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.01, one group, time-head lr multiplier=1
prospective_screening_not_authorized.data_context_and_time_statistics: original dataset contract; do not substitute derived statistics for legacy time-head launch arguments
prospective_screening_not_authorized.decision: no gate relaxation; all four datasets required before broad follow-up; seed expansion and held-out evaluation require separate approval
prospective_screening_not_authorized.runtime_launcher: future work; no server launcher or performance run in this implementation phase

local_numerical_tolerances.note: independent formula tolerance made explicit after a 2.22e-16 broadcast-layout rounding difference in the first local test; no performance threshold changed

local_acceptance: keys have independent storage and no extra RNG draws
initial weighted output equality and tied-gradient sum identity
key-only perturbation changes addressing and quantity predictions
nondegenerate quantity and time losses reach selected keys and values
original Hard-LMM and weighted paths remain unchanged
future/target/padding perturbations cannot change history prediction
series isolation and evaluation do not mutate static parameters
finite extreme-input forward/backward and optimizer steps
strict checkpoint metadata/state/optimizer replay; no legacy auto-conversion
synthetic tests only; no real-data fitting or held-out artifact
